original_question: For a compact Kahler manifold (X, omega) and a probability measure mu, determine whether the following are equivalent: first, there exists epsilon_mu > 0 such that exp(-epsilon_mu * PSH(X, omega)) is contained in L^1(mu); second, there exists a Holder continuous omega-plurisubharmonic function phi on X such that mu = MA(phi).
target_in_paper: Question 16 (DDGHKZ) in §2.4, “Hölder continuous solutions”: the authors ask whether the exponential integrability condition characterizes the range MA(Hol(X, ω)) of Monge-Ampère measures of Hölder continuous ω-plurisubharmonic functions. ([math.univ-toulouse.fr](https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~zeriahi/DGZ-arXiv2015.pdf))
correct_elements: Your draft already matches the paper’s actual target very closely: it has the right ambient setting of a compact Kähler manifold (X, ω), the right unknown object μ as a probability measure, the right two conditions, and the right equivalence question between an exponential integrability property and representability as the Monge-Ampère measure of a Hölder continuous ω-psh potential. This is exactly the content of Question 16 in §2.4. ([math.univ-toulouse.fr](https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~zeriahi/DGZ-arXiv2015.pdf))
missing_details: The paper states the problem for a compact Kähler manifold (X, ω) of complex dimension n; the dimension parameter n is present in the setup of §2.4, even though no extra restriction on n is imposed in the question itself. ([math.univ-toulouse.fr](https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~zeriahi/DGZ-arXiv2015.pdf))

The target class is named explicitly: Hol(X, ω) := PSH(X, ω) ∩ Holder(X), i.e. the Hölder continuous ω-plurisubharmonic functions on X. Making this notation explicit keeps the question paper-faithful. ([math.univ-toulouse.fr](https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~zeriahi/DGZ-arXiv2015.pdf))

The shorthand exp(-ε_μ PSH(X, ω)) ⊂ L^1(μ) should be unpacked as: there exists ε_μ > 0 such that for every ψ ∈ PSH(X, ω), one has e^{-ε_μ ψ} ∈ L^1(μ). ([math.univ-toulouse.fr](https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~zeriahi/DGZ-arXiv2015.pdf))

The Monge-Ampère operator MA(φ) should be defined using the paper’s normalization on compact Kähler manifolds: MA(φ) = c(ω + dd^cφ)^n with c = (∫_X ω^n)^(-1), so that MA(φ) is a probability measure. ([math.univ-toulouse.fr](https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~zeriahi/DGZ-arXiv2015.pdf))

The nearby motivation in the paper is not just an abstract equivalence problem: it is whether the exponential integrability property actually characterizes MA(Hol(X, ω)). That characterization language is part of the intended scope. ([math.univ-toulouse.fr](https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~zeriahi/DGZ-arXiv2015.pdf))

No specific Hölder exponent is fixed in the paper; the question asks only for existence of some Hölder continuous ω-psh potential, not for a prescribed C^{0,α} exponent. ([math.univ-toulouse.fr](https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~zeriahi/DGZ-arXiv2015.pdf))

The paper records known positive cases—n = 1 and the toric-symmetry case—so these should be mentioned only as context, not folded into the main question as extra assumptions. ([math.univ-toulouse.fr](https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~zeriahi/DGZ-arXiv2015.pdf))
refined_question: Let (X, ω) be a compact Kähler manifold of complex dimension n, let μ be a probability measure on X, let PSH(X, ω) denote the ω-plurisubharmonic functions on X, and let Hol(X, ω) := PSH(X, ω) ∩ Holder(X) be the set of Hölder continuous ω-psh functions. Writing MA(φ) := c(ω + dd^cφ)^n with c = (∫_X ω^n)^(-1), is it true that the following two properties are equivalent: (i) there exists ε_μ > 0 such that e^{-ε_μ ψ} ∈ L^1(μ) for every ψ ∈ PSH(X, ω); and (ii) there exists φ ∈ Hol(X, ω) such that μ = MA(φ)? ([math.univ-toulouse.fr](https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~zeriahi/DGZ-arXiv2015.pdf))
equivalent_formulation: Does the condition “there exists ε_μ > 0 such that exp(-ε_μ PSH(X, ω)) ⊂ L^1(μ)” characterize the range MA(Hol(X, ω)) of the normalized complex Monge-Ampère operator acting on Hölder continuous ω-plurisubharmonic functions? ([math.univ-toulouse.fr](https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~zeriahi/DGZ-arXiv2015.pdf))
justification: The draft is essentially a close paraphrase of Question 16 in §2.4. The surrounding text first defines Hol(X, ω), then recalls Skoda’s theorem and the Dinh–Nguyen–Sibony integrability result for Monge-Ampère measures of Hölder continuous ω-psh functions, and then asks whether this integrability property characterizes MA(Hol(X, ω)). The only substantive gaps in the draft are the paper’s explicit notation, the normalized definition of MA, and the unpacking of the shorthand integrability condition. ([math.univ-toulouse.fr](https://www.math.univ-toulouse.fr/~zeriahi/DGZ-arXiv2015.pdf))
